channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description: A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent as inflation hits holiday food prices
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with international residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce preserves the historic Crain Estate while offering artist residencies and art classes to residents of all skill levels in the Peacock Arts District.

item.title: Port St. Lucie expands Midway Road and adds Florida Turnpike interchange to accommodate growth
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved giving 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to build a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike at Midway Road, addressing a significant gap between current entrances and exits.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescued two boaters Wednesday after their small motorized boat took on water and became submerged in the Intracoastal Waterway.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman killed in home fire as community rallies to support surviving fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home, with preliminary findings from the sheriff's office pointing to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her insurance company Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield deny coverage for breast reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, citing the GalaFlex mesh as investigational.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes for $3 million renovation that will nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closed July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina beats Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and defending World Cup champion Argentina survived a scare from underdog Cape Verde, winning 3-2 in extra time Friday to advance to the Round of 16.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is preparing for a state championship run during the fall 2026 season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district title. item.description:

item.title: State Road 710 widening project delayed until 2031 despite safety concerns
item.description: Construction to widen State Road 710 from two lanes to four will not begin until 2031, according to the Florida Department of Transportation.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 near Indiantown
item.description: A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Martin County Fire Rescue responds to 42 vehicle crashes on State Road 710 this year
item.description: Martin County Fire Rescue has responded to 42 vehicle accident-related calls on State Road 710 in 2026.
